name: coldchain
description: ColdChain: vaccine & medicine storage monitor (FastRoboX 1.0 IoT hackathon)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.gen: python tools/gen_constants.py && node tools/gen_vectors.js && python tools/gen_wokwi.py
scripts.check:gen: python tools/gen_constants.py --check && node tools/gen_vectors.js --check && python tools/gen_wokwi.py --check
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint && ruff check ml tools
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format && ruff format ml tools
